description: NEAR Intents daily volume in USD per UTC day, as published by DefiLlama
provisional_rule: the 3 UTC days before fetch_day_utc may still be partial or restated upstream; values are kept as published (pipeline convention, matching the Explorer pull's open window; DefiLlama publishes no finality horizon)
refresh: full series re-downloaded every run (DefiLlama restates history when adapters change)
upstream: DefiLlama dexs/near-intents adapter: sum(volume_amount_usd) from Dune table dune.near.dataset_near_intents_metrics per date_at (not independent of Dune)
